styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy pastel baby-toy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft blush pink #F2DCE0, soft lavender #9B94C9 and violet accent #7C74B4 for headlines and icons; warm soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle even shadows and a dreamy glow; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; consistent rounded-rectangle info cards with small circular dot page markers; flat three-blade fan-shaped icons in violet; clean cute product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; product centered, upright and stable in scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no licensed cartoon characters or brand logos.

provenance.notes: 由 9 张 800x1200 详情页切片提炼，整套按详情页 2:3 竖版体系输出。已剥离：源图授权卡通形象与角色名（汪汪队形象、「阿奇」品名）、二维码促销块、平台水印字样、模板残留英文标题（源图出现「泡泡枪」字样与乱码文案）。安全与功效声称（无甲醛/无荧光剂、固齿磨牙、权威机构检测、ABS 材质）全部转为 {selling_point}/{callout} 槽位由商家填写，不构成事实声称；源图资质报告区无具体内容，信任镜改用一体成型外观、圆润边角与配重底盘等可验证视觉细节。分类：源文件夹为「母婴」，按图片实际内容精确归类为 母婴/玩具，与源夹一致；实拍仅 3 种色彩变体信息，多色标注按三种粉紫薄荷色具体描述。
